This data set contains forty-nine (49) registered scans of the Piggery at the Bar U Ranch National Historic Site. Two scanners were employed to collect the data, a Z+F 5010X and a Z+F 5016. The Z+F 5010X collected twenty-five (25) of the scans around the exterior of the Piggery. The Z+F 5016 collected twenty-four (24), twenty-three (23) of the scans were on the interior of the Piggery and one (1) on the exterior. The data was collected by the Digitally Preserving Alberta's Diverse Cultural Heritage team on September 17, 2020. All scabs were registered and processed in Z+F Laser Control v..
